definition.alternative: Governance validation may require looser tolerance or specialized evaluation metrics if structural state properties shift.
assumptions: Governance rule modules and state verification are fully deterministic under controlled protocol inputs.
Complete trial state arrays correctly reflect expected governance outcomes without missing fields.
definition.falsification: Divergent verification outputs or invalid measurements across identical protocol inputs and trial seeds.
definition.statement: Deterministic governance modules and receipt-backed validation layers maintain invariant transition verification accuracy across multiple invocation turns when evaluated with explicit, complete trial state arrays.
definition.uncertainty: Handling of edge cases in state verification requires robust trial definitions to avoid invalid measurement outcomes.

definition.method: Execute numeric observation evaluation with fully specified trial fields to ensure valid measurement of deterministic governance verification.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    trials = inputs.get('trials', [])
    scores = []
    for trial in trials:
        expected = trial.get('expected_state')
        actual = trial.get('state')
        proposal = trial.get('proposal')
        valid = 1.0 if (expected == actual and proposal is not None) else 0.0
        scores.append(valid)
    avg = sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0.0
    return {'measurements': {'accuracy': [avg]}}
definition.stop: Successful validation of deterministic verification without invalid measurement flags.
definition.success: Measurement returns valid accuracy equal to 1.0 across all trials.

definition.cost: Minimal computational overhead for protocol execution.
definition.reason: Previous measurement was invalid due to incomplete structural expectations; testing with explicit trial definitions will clarify governance verification performance.
definition.stop_condition: Successful completion and valid measurement of deterministic verification accuracy.
definition.uncertainty: Uncertain whether refined trial structures will completely resolve invalid measurement outcomes.
